posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Naganyte said:
And when i use an attack first and then a stance it will add the buffs after i do the attack.
Click to expand...
you need to use skill speed for the stances.
the action order is based on (battler.agi + skill.speed + random%), sorted highest to lowest.
so if you give all stance-skills a speed of +1000 or so, they will usually be executed before skills with speed 0 (unless the AGI of a different actor is high enough).
Naganyte said:
for example in my game i want the turn to be in 2 parts, one where you select your stance (defensive, offensive, etc.) and one where you select your attack,
Click to expand...
consider going the other direction: have two different turns and then one turn only allow stances and the following allow only actions.
this can be done with states sealing certain skills, and you apply the states at an end turn troop event (with a base troop plugin to prevent you from having it to copy everywhere).
it will be a bit tricky to set everything up that way, but still easier than your other approach

of course not, and that is not what I described. you need to remove all action times+ traits if you want to go the way I described.
you need to make two states, one disabling the stances and one disabling the action skills.
then you need to make a troop event that triggers on turns 1,3,5,7,9 and so on to disable the stances for the next turn, and a second troop event triggering on turn 0,2,4,6,8 and so on disabling the action skills on the next turn
